name: PocketShell Quiet
model: Host → Root → Workspace (canonical folder) → Session → real terminal
disclaimer: Offline interaction and layout prototype. All connections, processes, keys, usage, files and transfers are illustrative. No SSH, microphone, camera, credential, file-write or network operations run.
constraints: Workspaces are folders in roots and can have zero, one or many sessions.
Do not duplicate folder name and full path in workspace rows.
Flat lists, larger type, monochrome session marks and text.
Metadata is not a tiny button. The whole row is the target.
Session status must not conflate running, attached, busy or connected.
Start directly in a root, choose existing folders, or explicitly create missing folders.

screens.title: Hosts
screens.description: The occasional machine switcher, not a new dashboard.
notes: Opening the app resumes the last host workspace list when configured.
Do not claim a saved host is online before a connection check.
Rows stay flat; last-opened is metadata, not a status probe.
